description: Parse a decimal integer from text. The text is valid if it is an optional single leading '-' followed by one or more ASCII digits 0-9, with nothing else (no spaces, no '+', no other characters). Fail with Empty if the text is empty, Invalid if it is not valid, OutOfRange if the value does not fit in a signed 64-bit integer.

pub type ParseError do
  case Empty
  case Invalid
  case OutOfRange
end type ParseError

  case Overflow

description: Decide whether a user-supplied path is a safe relative path inside a directory. It is safe only if: it is not empty; it does not start with '/'; it contains no backslash '\' and no ':'; and, split on '/', every segment is non-empty and is neither '.' nor '..'.
tessera_signature: pub fn is_safe_relative_path(path: Str) -> bool

description: Check a number with the Luhn checksum. The input may contain ASCII digits 0-9 and space characters; spaces are ignored. Return false if any other character is present or if there are fewer than 2 digits. Otherwise, starting from the rightmost digit, double every second digit (subtract 9 if the result is above 9), sum everything, and return true if the sum is a multiple of 10.
tessera_signature: pub fn luhn_valid(number: Str) -> bool

Return one boolean per request. window is always positive and limit is never negative.
